task_description: Write a method in Dafny that takes in two sequences and performs mathematical division operation element-wise across the given sequences.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ElementWiseDivision(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the result sequence should be the same as the length of the input sequences
    - For each index i, if b[i] ≠ 0, result[i] should be equal to a[i] divided by b[i] (integer division)
    - For each index i, if b[i] = 0, the corresponding result element should be defined appropriately (e.g., zero or unspecified, depending on intended behavior)
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method ElementWiseDivision(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - Both sequences should be non-null
    - Both sequences should have the same length
    - All elements in the second sequence (b) should be non-zero
    
Dafny specification:
    requires a != null && b != null
    requires |a| == |b|
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |b| ==> b[i] != 0
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result sequence should have the same length as the input sequences
    - Each element in the result sequence should be the division of the corresponding elements in the input sequences
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |a|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == a[i] / b[i]
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method ElementWiseDivision(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires a != null && b != null
    requires |a| == |b|
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |b| ==> b[i] != 0
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |a|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == a[i] / b[i]
{
    var res := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < |a|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |a|
        invariant |res| == i
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> res[k] == a[k] / b[k]
    {
        res := res + [a[i] / b[i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
    return res;
}
```
